propositions: Job-level always() predicates remain true during workflow cancellation, preventing stale matrix and reusable jobs from being canceled promptly
Seven full-route jobs introduced by commit 6f4123678c do not cancel when a superseding patchset is created, delaying successor job admission and wasting runner capacity
Replacing always() with !cancelled() status checks in full-route job predicates preserves classifier-failure fallback behavior while enabling prompt cancellation on superseding patchsets
Live evidence from organic same-change replacements confirms stale full-route jobs now conclude canceled within 60-110 seconds after replacement creation, without delaying successor admission
